trademark.details: No USPTO registration found for 'CYTHERIS' via web search or Trademarkia. Company was French (would have filed with INPI/EUIPO), but company entered judicial liquidation in 2013. Trademark rights typically lapse if not maintained during/after liquidation. Revimmune SAS rebranded away from Cytheris name, suggesting they did not maintain the trademark.
risks: INPI/EUIPO registration could not be directly verified (databases require direct access)
Revimmune SAS is the legal successor — could theoretically assert common law rights to the name
UDRP risk is LOW: Cytheris SA is liquidated, Revimmune rebranded, no active commerce under 'Cytheris' brand
'Cytheris' is a coined word (from ancient Roman freedwoman Volumnia Cytheris) — no generic meaning to conflict with
trademark.udrp_risk: LOW — company liquidated 2013, successor rebranded, no active use of 'Cytheris' mark, 13+ years of non-use
trademark.recommendation: PROCEED WITH CAUTION — monitor for any INPI/EUIPO revival but probability is very low given 13 years of abandonment

competition.details: No search results for 'cytheris.com expired domain' or any backorder listings. This is a niche biotech name with zero mainstream appeal — unlikely to attract domainers. The only potential competitor would be Revimmune SAS (the successor), and they rebranded away from the name.
competition.godaddy_auction_risk: MEDIUM — GoDaddy expired domain auctions attract professional domainers who scan all expiring .com domains. A 24-year-old .com will get noticed. However, the pharmaceutical-sounding name limits mainstream buyer interest.

name_analysis.memorability: MEDIUM — not intuitive but memorable once heard

domain_value.flip_analysis: Limited buyer pool (biotech startups, pharma naming agencies). The name sounds pharmaceutical but is too specific/branded to be a generic biotech keyword domain. Value primarily comes from: (1) 24-year domain age, (2) potential backlink equity from $45.7M company period, (3) clean .com. Not a premium flip — this is a moderate-value speculative catch.
domain_value.best_buyer_profile: Early-stage biotech startup looking for a professional-sounding .com, or a domain investor building a pharma/biotech portfolio
domain_value.comparable_sales: Coined pharma-style 8-char .com domains with history typically sell $500-$3,000 on aftermarket
